description: Press at one point, move, release at another — the other half of canvas work, and the half a click cannot express: moving a shape, marqueeing a selection, panning, drawing a box, dragging a handle. Without it an agent fakes a drag out of two clicks and changes something nobody asked for. The pointer is moved in STEPS between the two points (12 by default), because a single jump from start to end is not a drag to most canvas code — it tracks the pointer while the button is down, and one giant delta reads as a glitch or as nothing at all. The moves go to the element the drag STARTED on, which is what a browser does once a button is down. Same coordinates and the same honest limit as qa_click_point: CSS pixels from the top-left of the viewport, and `isTrusted: false`. Requires the one-time “Agent control” confirmation in the panel; without it the extension answers consent-required and does nothing.

steps.description: How many pointermove events to send between the two points (2–60, default 12). More for a canvas that samples the path, fewer for a simple handle.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

toX.description: End — CSS pixels from the LEFT of the viewport

toY.description: End — CSS pixels from the TOP of the viewport

x.description: Start — CSS pixels from the LEFT of the viewport

y.description: Start — CSS pixels from the TOP of the viewport

name: qa_drag_point
title: Drag from one point to another on a canvas
